Strategy: Apply the sweet-band reward between thirty and forty-five only when at least five bins are open, with the penalty widened to residuals between five and twenty-five. This combines the best gate with a broader awkward range, but the wider penalty may punish residuals that later items could use.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if len(bins) >= 5 and r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 5 and r - item <= 25 else 0) for r in bins]
```
